description: Set a gate to passed only after its evidence has been verified for this release. Do not include credentials.

gates.requirement: Backend replays committed bookings correctly and handles failed, pending and concurrent retries.
Fresh and existing database migrations pass; production schema validation is verified.
Authenticated profile-save and account-timezone contracts are implemented and tested, or an approved support-only release scope is recorded.
OTP, signed uploads, Stripe test payments/webhooks/cancellation/refunds and ownership denials pass; dev CI including secret scan passes for the candidate.
Supported Safari and Firefox flows are verified in addition to Chromium.
